description:
# Compliance child for opi-q5k.40 (opi-q5k.5 / editor.test.ts)

## Scope

Upstream L283-310: 'returns cursor position' and 'returns lines as defensive copy'. Elixir uses direct struct field access — no accessor tests needed in strict sense, BUT if Input exposes any helper that returns lines, verify it returns a NEW list (not mutable shared state — Elixir lists are immutable, but any mutable assumption should be documented).

## Protocol

1. Read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/editor.test.ts; locate the "public state accessors" describe.
2. Enumerate every it(...) under that describe.
3. For each, find or confirm absent an equivalent Elixir assertion in apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs (grep if unsure).
4. Implement any missing behavior in OctoPi.TUI.Components.Input (or related modules).
5. Port the missing tests to input_test.exs (under a new describe "editor-parity: public state accessors" or integrated with existing describes where they fit).
6. Re-read tmp/pi-mono editor.test.ts "public state accessors" top-to-bottom and confirm every it(...) has an Elixir equivalent.
7. Post a final comment documenting the mapping (upstream test → Elixir test).
8. Close this child.

## Deps
Blocks opi-q5k.40 (which blocks opi-q5k.1).
title: editor.test.ts / public state accessors (2 upstream tests)
